title: Children talk about witnessing the 1994 UFO landing at the Ariel School in Ruwa, Zimbabwe
description:
"On September 16, 1994 there was a UFO sighting outside Ruwa, Zimbabwe. 62 students at the Ariel School aged between six and twelve claimed that they saw one or more silver craft descend from the sky and land on a field near their school. One or more creatures dressed all in black then approached the children and telepathically communicated to them a message with an environmental theme." (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ariel_School_UFO_incident)
